title: default_injection_source choice not explained
description: crates/core/src/injection_source.rs: default_injection_source() returns SmtpSieve with no explanation for why SmtpSieve is the right default for backward-compatible deserialization of old queue files rather than NntpPost or SmtpNewsgroups. A contributor maintaining the queue serialization format or adding a new injection source has no basis for evaluating whether SmtpSieve is correct. Add a comment explaining: (1) which queue file format uses this default, (2) why SmtpSieve was chosen (e.g. the queue files in question were created before the enum variant was added, and SmtpSieve is peerable which preserves the pre-existing behavior).
